scope: 整数版の大きな階乗表の高速化。本体の比較は各問題で同じ愚直なmainを使う。

online_before.source_match: Equal after CRLF normalization, ignoring formatting whitespace outside string/character literals and comments, and // Submission: metadata only.

online_after: 未提出。本体とmainを変更したため過去230msと現在版の判定は区別する。
license: CC0-1.0。自己実装と数学的恒等式による改修。外部の高速提出コードは取り込んでいない。
changes: 大表では4項をまとめ、i(i+1)の差分で2項積を更新する。
全表の逆階乗はWilsonの定理から逆向きコピーと符号反転で構築する。
4096未満の表は元の計算ループを維持し、大表処理をprivate helperへ分けて小表の後退を解消する。
公開API・options上限・自動拡張・計算予算・所有権・検査切替・標準算術の代替を維持する。
mainの独自入出力・バッチ化は採用せず、通常cin/coutへ整理。

proofs.forward_pair: (i+2)(i+3)=i(i+1)+4i+6。4target+6<pなら、ループ内の差分4i+6,4i+14はいずれもp未満で、1回の補正で剰余を保つ。
proofs.backward_pair: (i-2)(i-3)=i(i-1)-(4i-6)。ループ条件i>old_size+3とold_size>=1から差分は正。4target+6<pにより1回の補正で足りる。
proofs.wilson: pは素数、target=p-1>=4096なのでpは奇数。ifac[k]=(-1)^(k+1)*fac[p-1-k] mod p。旧範囲は触らず、追加範囲だけを作る。
proofs.ownership: vectorの確保と例外時のサイズ復元は従来のensure_factorialsで完了し、計算helperに確保はない。

official_and_phase_comparison.main_policy: All before/after programs in each problem use identical plain cin/cout main. No custom I/O or batching.

followup_21.reason: Initial 7-run mod3_00 difference and variation in the identical binary control for the largest prime case.

correctness.reference: 独立した積・逆元の参照と旧版照合。大素数3法で各1万件、境界・段階拡張・合成数の76.5万件。

rejected_experiments: 独自I/O・照会256件のバッチ処理は本体の高速化に含めず、不採用。

reproduction.fixed_main_measurement_script:
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import statistics
import subprocess
import time

p=Path(__file__).parent
root=Path('/home/reinsirk/Atcoder_Env')
prev=Path('/tmp/atcoder_binomial_regression_20261019/performance')
out=p/'final_fixed_main'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
libraries={'before':(p/'before_library.cpp').read_text(),
           'after':(root/'Math/Combination/Binomial_Mod.cpp').read_text()}
(p/'kernel.cpp').write_text(libraries['after'])
for tag,source in [('before',p/'before_library.cpp'),('kernel',p/'kernel.cpp')]:
    for test in ['scenarios','micro_final']:
        subprocess.run(['g++','-std=c++23','-O2','-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS',f'-DBINOMIAL_SOURCE="{source}"',str(prev/(test+'.cpp')),'-o',str(p/(tag+'_'+test))],check=True,capture_output=True)
drivers={kind:(root/'Verify/current/drivers'/filename).read_text() for kind,filename in
         [('prime','binomial_integer_prime_mod_main.cpp'),('integer','binomial_integer_main.cpp')]}
exes={};builds=[]
for kind,driver in drivers.items():
    for tag,library in libraries.items():
        src=out/f'{kind}_{tag}.cpp'
        src.write_text('#define SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS\n'+library+'\n'+driver)
        exe=out/f'{kind}_{tag}'
        cmd=['g++','-std=c++23','-O2',str(src),'-o',str(exe)]
        subprocess.run(cmd,check=True,capture_output=True)
        exes[kind,tag]=exe
        builds.append({'kind':kind,'tag':tag,'command':cmd,'library_sha256':sha(library.encode()),
                       'driver_sha256':sha(driver.encode()),'source_sha256':sha(src.read_bytes())})
    exe=out/f'{kind}_control'
    shutil.copyfile(exes[kind,'before'],exe);exe.chmod(0o755);exes[kind,'control']=exe

history={}
for id_ in [411667,411677]:
    s=(p/f'submitted_{id_}.cpp').read_text()
    src=out/f'history_{id_}.cpp'
    src.write_text(s[:s.rfind('int main')]+drivers['integer'])
    exe=out/f'history_{id_}'
    subprocess.run(['g++','-std=c++23','-O2',str(src),'-o',str(exe)],check=True,capture_output=True)
    history[str(id_)]=exe

source=Path('/tmp/atcoder_verify_20261019/official/library-checker-problems-master/enumerative_combinatorics/binomial_coefficient_prime_mod')
official=json.loads((source/'hash.json').read_text())
prime_dir=Path('/tmp/atcoder_prime_mod_io_20261020/cases')
cases={'prime':[prime_dir/n for n in sorted(official) if n.endswith('.in')],
       'integer':sorted((prev/'fixtures').glob('*.in'))}
answer_dirs={'prime':p/'answers','integer':prev/'answers'}
checks=[]
for kind,inputs in cases.items():
    for inp in inputs:
        expected=(answer_dirs[kind]/(inp.stem+'.out')).read_bytes()
        for tag in ['before','after']:
            with inp.open('rb')as si:
                data=subprocess.check_output([str(exes[kind,tag])],stdin=si)
            assert data==expected,(kind,tag,inp)
            checks.append({'kind':kind,'case':inp.stem,'tag':tag,'input_sha256':sha(inp.read_bytes()),'output_sha256':sha(data)})
print('Same-main official output checks:',len(checks),flush=True)
rows=[];extended=[];micro=[];history_rows=[]
with open('/tmp/atcoder_full_performance_20261018/benchmark.lock','w')as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX);os.sched_setaffinity(0,{14})
    for rep in range(7):
        for kind,inputs in cases.items():
            for ci,inp in enumerate(inputs):
                tags=['before','after','control'];shift=(rep+ci)%3;tags=tags[shift:]+tags[:shift]
                for tag in tags:
                    with inp.open('rb')as si:
                        start=time.perf_counter_ns()
                        subprocess.run([str(exes[kind,tag])],stdin=si,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,check=True)
                        dt=time.perf_counter_ns()-start
                    rows.append({'kind':kind,'case':inp.stem,'tag':tag,'rep':rep,'ns':dt})
        print('Fixed-main rotation',rep+1,'/ 7',flush=True)
        (out/'timings.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
    # All historic integer libraries use exactly the same plain main here.
    names=['m_510510_n_max_00','m_524288_n_max_00','m_720720_n_max_00']
    for rep in range(5):
        for name in names:
            tags=['411667','411677'];shift=rep%2;tags=tags[shift:]+tags[:shift]
            for tag in tags:
                with (prev/'fixtures'/(name+'.in')).open('rb')as si:
                    start=time.perf_counter_ns();subprocess.run([str(history[tag])],stdin=si,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,check=True);dt=time.perf_counter_ns()-start
                history_rows.append({'case':name,'library_from_submission':tag,'rep':rep,'ns':dt})
    # Existing API phase scenarios; output and checksums are compared as well.
    sums={}
    for rep in range(5):
        tags=['before','kernel'] if rep%2==0 else ['kernel','before']
        for tag in tags:
            for kind in ['scenarios','micro_final']:
                cmd=[str(p/(tag+'_'+kind))]+([str(prev/'scenarios.tsv')]if kind=='scenarios'else[])
                text=subprocess.check_output(cmd,text=True)
                (out/f'{tag}_{kind}_{rep}.csv').write_text(text)
                for line in text.splitlines():
                    a=line.split(',')
                    if kind=='scenarios':
                        key=tuple(a[:1]);value=tuple(a[5:]);row={'case':a[0],'tag':tag,'rep':rep,**dict(zip(['construct_ns','prepare_ns','first_ns','batch_ns'],map(float,a[1:5])))};extended.append(row)
                    else:
                        key=tuple(a[:2]);value=tuple(a[3:]);row={'case':a[0],'phase':a[1],'tag':tag,'rep':rep,'ns':float(a[2])};micro.append(row)
                    skey=(kind,key)
                    if skey in sums:assert sums[skey]==value,(skey,tag)
                    sums[skey]=value
        print('API phase rotation',rep+1,'/ 5',flush=True)

summary=[]
for kind,inputs in cases.items():
    for inp in inputs:
        r={'kind':kind,'case':inp.stem}
        for tag in ['before','after','control']:
            r[tag+'_ms']=statistics.median(x['ns']for x in rows if(x['kind'],x['case'],x['tag'])==(kind,inp.stem,tag))/1e6
        r['ratio']=r['after_ms']/r['before_ms'];summary.append(r)
report={'compiler':subprocess.check_output(['g++','--version'],text=True).splitlines()[0],
        'cpu':14,'repetitions':7,'builds':builds,'checks':checks,'official_timings':rows,
        'summary':summary,'history_with_same_plain_main':history_rows,
        'api_phase_repetitions':5,'extended':extended,'micro':micro,
        'main_policy':'All before/after programs in each problem use identical plain cin/cout main. No custom I/O or batching.'}
(out/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
for r in summary:
    if r['case'] in ['mod998244353_maxi_00','mod998244353_00','mod2_00','med_random_00',*names]:print(r,flush=True)
print('DONE',len(summary),'official cases;',len(sums),'API phases',flush=True)
